description: Multi-size DEX token liquidity, sell slippage, AMM price impact curve, and honeypot/exit risk matrix across USD position tiers before trading. Not advice. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

chain.description: optional chain filter: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, arc, robinhood or solana

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

sizesUsd.description: optional 1 to 6 comma-separated USD position sizes to model (default 100,1000,10000,50000)

token.description: token contract address (0x + 40 hex on EVM) or base58 Solana mint

name: token_exit_matrix
title: Token exit matrix
